verdict.rationale: Bolna documents API-driven multi-step workflows that combine calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, which gives some time-based automation. Its CLI also manages call batches. Neither source mentions recurring schedules, cron-style triggers or scheduled batch runs, so support for recurring jobs is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron scheduling of workflows or batches, documented schedule configuration (timezones, intervals), independent or hands-on corroboration.
